crossRefs.note: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.
They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for…

translations.web: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.
translations.bsb: when we are slandered, we answer gently. Up to this moment we have become the scum of the earth, the refuse of the world.
translations.kjv: Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.
translations.asv: being defamed, we entreat: we are made as the filth of the world, the offscouring of all things, even until now.
